items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The last one-nighter I played with him, I got fifty dollars, and he gave me fifty dollars.

ctx.x: Yeah. And Coridge asked the guy who was managing the band, named Vandenberg... He told me, 'Phil, how would you like to make about a month with Louis Jordan?' I said, 'Fine.' Because Louis Jordan was making some money then. You were getting $40 and $50 a night for one-nighters. The last one-nighter I played with him, I got fifty dollars, and he gave me fifty dollars. That was in Atlanta, Georgia -- my last night.
Bet you wanted to stay with him, huh?
